title: A2-15 · The weak verbs at all times

blocks.text: A2-15 · The weak verbs at all times
Lesson overview

Many of the most frequent verbs have in the root a ⁧و⁩ or a ⁧ي⁩ : ⁧وَصَلَ⁩ • arrive • • ⁧قَالَ⁩ "Simple' means: ⁧بَاعَ⁩ "Sell" is the name of the manufacturer. ⁧مَشَى⁩ "walking" is the term "walking," ⁧نَسِيَ⁩ Forget about it. You've met them time by time (A2-02 → A2-06); in this unit you put them in line at all times and ways, with summary tables, and learn the few rules that explain all forms: ⁧و⁩ which falls into the assimilated, the long vowel that shortens in the concave, the final vowel that changes or falls into the defective. The context is the story: a tourist who lost his passport, a weekend in the mountains, a news. Two weeks.

blocks.text: Materials This unit, Anki deck A2 (tag A2-15), script for speech synthesis, session with tutor
Targets. At the end of the lesson you know:
1. recognize the three types of weak verb from the root: assimilated ( ⁧و⁩ at the beginning), concave ( ⁧و⁩ / ⁧ي⁩ in the middle), defective ( ⁧و⁩ / ⁧ي⁩ at the end);
2. combine in all times and ways ⁧وَصَلَ⁩ , ⁧قَالَ⁩ , ⁧بَاعَ⁩ , ⁧خَافَ⁩ , ⁧دَعَا⁩ , ⁧مَشَى⁩ , ⁧نَسِيَ⁩ and the verbs that follow the same models;
3. forming participles and maṣdar the most frequent weak verbs ( ⁧قَائِل⁩ , ⁧مَاشٍ⁩ , ⁧وُصُول⁩ , ⁧نِسْيَان⁩ );
4. Rediscover the root of a short form ( ⁧قُلْتُ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَقُلْ⁩ , ⁧صِلْ⁩ , ⁧لَمْ يَنْسَ⁩ , ⁧اِمْشِ⁩ );
5. tell facts to the past and understand news with many weak verbs.
Two-week plan.

1. Dialogue 1 · The lost passport
Commissioner, door. A Moroccan tourist (invented) lost his passport. Karīm translates, Luca asks the questions.

rows: Luca: When did you arrive in Milan?
⁧السَّائِح: وَصَلْتُ أَوَّلَ أَمْسِ مَعَ زَوْجَتِي. نَزَلْنَا فِي فُنْدُقٍ قُرْبَ المَحَطَّةِ.⁩
as-sāʾiḥ: waṣaltu awwala amsi maʿa zawǧatī. nazalnā fī funduqin qurba l- maḥaṭṭa.
Tourist: I arrived the day before yesterday with my wife. We went down to a hotel near the station.
Lūkā: wa-ayna waḍaʿta ǧawāza s- safar?
And where did you put your passport?
⁧السَّائِح: وَضَعْتُهُ فِي حَقِيبَةِ الظَّهْرِ. هٰذَا الصَّبَاحَ أَرَدْتُ أَنْ أُغَيِّرَ مَالًا، فَلَمْ أَجِدْهُ.⁩
as-sāʾiḥ: waḍaʿtuhu fī ḥaqībati ẓ-ẓahr. hāḏā ṣ-ṣabāḥa aradtu an uġayyira mālan, fa-lam aǧidh.
I put it in my backpack. I wanted to change some money this morning, and I didn't find it.
⁧كَرِيم: هَلْ نِمْتُمْ فِي الفُنْدُقِ كُلَّ اللَّيْلِ، أَمْ خَرَجْتُمْ؟⁩
Karīm: hal nimtum fī l-funduqi kulla l- layl, am ḫaraǧtum?
Karīm: Did you sleep at the hotel all night or did you go out?
⁧السَّائِح: خَرَجْنَا مَسَاءً. مَشَيْنَا فِي وَسَطِ المَدِينَةِ، وَزُرْنَا الكَاتِدْرَائِيَّةَ، ثُمَّ عُدْنَا بِالمِتْرُو.⁩
as-sāʾiḥ: ḫaraǧnā masāʾan. mašaynā fī wasaṭi l-madīna, wa-zurnā l- kātidrāʾiyya, ṯumma ʿudnā bi-l-mitrū.
Tourist: We went out in the evening. We walked downtown, visited the Duomo and then went back to the subway.
⁧لُوكَا: هَلْ بِعْتَ شَيْئًا، أَوِ اشْتَرَيْتَ شَيْئًا مِنْ شَخْصٍ فِي الشَّارِعِ؟⁩
Lūkā: hal biʿta šayʾan, awi štarayta šayʾan min šaḫṣin fī š-šāriʿ?
Luca: Did you sell or buy something from someone on the street?
⁧السَّائِح: لَا، لَمْ أَبِعْ وَلَمْ أَشْتَرِ شَيْئًا. لٰكِنْ فِي المِتْرُو وَقَفَ قُرْبِي رَجُلَانِ، وَكَانَ هُنَاكَ زِحَامٌ شَدِيدٌ.⁩
as-sāʾiḥ: lā, lam abiʿ wa-lam aštari šayʾā. lākin fī l-mitrū waqafa qurbī raǧulāni, wa-kāna hunāka ziḥāmun šadīd.
Tourist: No, I didn't sell or buy anything. But on the subway two men were standing next to me, and there was a lot of fighting.
⁧كَرِيم: لَا تَخَفْ. سَنَكْتُبُ مَحْضَرًا، وَسَتَأْخُذُهُ إِلَى قُنْصُلِيَّةِ المَغْرِبِ.⁩
Karīm: lā taḫaf. sa-naktubu maḥḍaran, wa-sa-taʾḫuḏuhu ilā qunṣuliyyati l- maġrib.
Karīm: Don't be afraid. We write a report and you will take it to the Moroccan consulate.
⁧السَّائِح: خِفْتُ كَثِيرًا، لِأَنَّنَا سَنَعُودُ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ.⁩
as-sāʾiḥ: ḫiftu kaṯīran, li-annanā sa- naʿūdu yawma l-aḥad.

2. Recognizing weak verbs
A root is weak when it contains ⁧و⁩ or ⁧ي⁩ (weak letters) which in conjugation can stretch, shorten or fall.

rows: ⁧قَالَي⁩ ( ⁧خ و ف⁩ ) ⁧خَافَ⁩ ,( ⁧ب ي ع⁩ ) ⁧بَاعَ⁩ ,( ⁧ق و ل⁩ )

blocks.text: defective 3a radical ⁧و⁩ / ⁧ي⁩ ( ⁧ن س ي⁩ ) ⁧نَسِيَ⁩ ,( ⁧م ش ي⁩ ) ⁧مَشَى⁩ ,( ⁧د ع و⁩ ) ⁧دَعَا⁩ ⁧نَاقِص⁩

How to find the root of a short form: if there are no letters, ask yourself which weak letter has fallen. ⁧صِلْ⁩ : two consonants, ⁧ص ل⁩ → missing the first: ⁧و ص ل. قُلْ⁩ : ⁧ق ل⁩ → the second one is missing: ⁧ق و ل. اِمْشِ⁩ : ⁧م ش⁩ → the third is missing: ⁧م ش ي⁩ . The Dictionary (A2-01) always sort by complete root.
3. Assimilates: ⁧و⁩ falling
1. The perfect one is regular.
2. In the imperfect and imperative the ⁧و⁩ falls into verbs with imperfect in i: ⁧وَصَلَ⁩ → ⁧يَصِلُ⁩ , ⁧صِلْ⁩ ; ⁧وَجَدَ⁩ → ⁧يَجِدُ⁩ ;

⁧وَقَفَ⁩ → ⁧يَقِفُ⁩ ; ⁧وَعَدَ⁩ → ⁧يَعِدُ⁩ "Promise' means: ⁧وَصَفَ⁩ → ⁧يَصِفُ⁩ (b) describe the goods; ⁧وَثِقَ⁩ → ⁧يَثِقُ⁩ • trust it • ⁧وَرِثَ⁩ → ⁧يَرِثُ⁩ Inheriting the goods; ⁧وَلَدَ⁩ → ⁧يَلِدُ⁩ • to give birth. It falls also in some verbs in to: ⁧وَضَعَ⁩ → ⁧يَضَعُ⁩ , ⁧ضَعْ⁩ ; ⁧وَقَعَ⁩ → ⁧يَقَعُ⁩ .
3. The imperative does not have the vowel of support: it starts directly with the consonant: ⁧صِلْ⁩ , ⁧ضَعْ⁩ , ⁧قِفْ⁩ Stop it!
4. The ⁧و⁩ remains in derived forms ( ⁧أَوْصَلَ⁩ , ⁧يُوصِلُ⁩ , A2-10) and in participle ( ⁧وَاصِل⁩ ).

The rule of the two bases (A2-02): long vowel when the syllable is open, short vocal when the syllable closes with a consonant (in front of the suffixes in consonant, in the juxive, in the imperative).

5. Dialogue 2 · A weekend in the mountains
Monday morning. Maria tells Luca about her weekend.

rows: Luca: How did you spend the weekend?
⁧مَارِيَا: فِي الجَبَلِ مَعَ أُخْتِي. مَشَيْنَا خَمْسَ سَاعَاتٍ يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ!⁩
Māriyā: fī l-ǧabali maʿa uḫtī. mašaynā ḫamsa sāʿātin yawma s-sabt!
In the mountains with my sister. Saturday we walked five hours!
Five hours? And you didn't get tired?
⁧مَارِيَا: تَعِبْنَا كَثِيرًا، لِأَنَّنِي نَسِيتُ المَاءَ فِي السَّيَّارَةِ! أُخْتِي لَمْ تَنْسَ شَيْئًا، طَبْعًا.⁩
Māriyā: taʿibnā kaṯīran, li-annanī nasītu l-māʾa fī s-sayyāra! uḫtī lam tansa šayʾan, ṭabʿan.
Maria: We got really tired, because I forgot the water in the car! My sister hasn't forgotten anything, of course.
Luca: And where did you stay at night?
⁧مَارِيَا: فِي بَيْتٍ صَغِيرٍ يُدِيرُهُ رَجُلٌ عَجُوزٌ. دَعَانَا إِلَى العَشَاءِ، وَحَكَى لَنَا قِصَصًا عَنِ الجَبَلِ حَتَّى مُنْتَصَفِ اللَّيْلِ.⁩
Māriyā: fī baytin ṣaġīrin yudīruhu raǧulun ʿaǧūz. daʿānā ilā l-ʿašāʾ, wa- ḥakā lanā qiṣaṣan ʿani l-ǧabali ḥattā muntaṣafi l-layl.
In a little house run by an elderly gentleman. She invited us to dinner and told us stories about the mountain until midnight.
⁧مَارِيَا: أَرَدْنَا أَنْ نَمْشِيَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى، لٰكِنَّ المَطَرَ بَدَأَ. لِذٰلِكَ بَقِينَا فِي البَيْتِ، وَلَعِبْنَا الوَرَقَ مَعَ الرَّجُلِ. هُوَ لَمْ يَخْسَرْ وَلَا مَرَّةً!⁩
Māriyā: aradnā an namšiya marratan uḫrā, lākinna l-maṭara badaʾ. li-ḏālika baqīnā fī l-bayt, wa-laʿibnā l-waraqa maʿa r-raǧul. huwa lam yaḫsar wa-lā marra!
We wanted to walk again, but it started raining. So we stayed in the house and played cards with the gentleman. He didn't lose once!
⁧لُوكَا: أَرْجُو أَنْ تَدْعُوَانِي فِي المَرَّةِ القَادِمَةِ.⁩
Lūkā: arǧū an tadʿuwānī fī l-marrati l- qādima.
I hope you invite me next time.
Māriyā: iḏā lam tansa l-māʾ… fa- ttafaqnā!
If you don't forget the water... we agree!

6. The defects: three models
⁧دَعَا⁩ Invite the following ⁧د ع و⁩ ): -ā / -ū
So: ⁧رَجَا يَرْجُو⁩ • hope, pray • ⁧رَجَوْتُ⁩ ), ⁧شَكَا يَشْكُو⁩ • complain • ( ⁧شَكَوْتُ⁩ ), ⁧بَدَا يَبْدُو⁩ It looks like it's gonna be.
⁧مَشَى⁩ Walking ( ⁧م ش ي⁩ ): -ā / -ī

So: ⁧بَكَى يَبْكِي⁩ "Weeping" is the most common form of the word. ⁧حَكَى يَحْكِي⁩ • tell the story, ⁧رَمَى يَرْمِي⁩ "Toss', ⁧جَرَى يَجْرِي⁩ Run; future (s) of the product (s), ⁧بَنَى يَبْنِي⁩ , ⁧قَضَى يَقْضِي⁩ , ⁧اِشْتَرَى يَشْتَرِي⁩ (form VIII), ⁧أَعْطَى يُعْطِي⁩ (form IV), ⁧اِلْتَقَى يَلْتَقِي⁩ • meet (form VIII).
⁧نَسِيَ⁩ Forget about it ( ⁧ن س ي⁩ ): -iya / -ā

So: ⁧بَقِيَ يَبْقَى⁩ • to remain in the Union; ⁧لَقِيَ يَلْقَى⁩ • meet • • ⁧رَضِيَ يَرْضَى⁩ • be satisfied • This model also follows derived forms with the imperfect in -ā, as ⁧تَمَنَّى يَتَمَنَّى⁩ (form V); those with the imperfect in -ī, as ⁧اِنْتَهَى يَنْتَهِي⁩ , follow ⁧مَشَى⁩ . Three rules for all defects.
1. In the juxtaposition and in the imperative, the final long vowel shortens: ⁧يَدْعُو⁩ → ⁧لَمْ يَدْعُ⁩ , ⁧يَمْشِي⁩ → ⁧اِمْشِ⁩ , ⁧يَنْسَى⁩ → ⁧لَمْ⁩
2. In conjunction the forms in -ū and -ī take the -a ( ⁧أَنْ يَدْعُوَ⁩ , ⁧أَنْ يَمْشِيَ⁩ ); in -ā do not change ( ⁧أَنْ يَنْسَى⁩ ).
3. With desinence -ū / -ūna The root vowel melts: ⁧مَشَوْا⁩ , ⁧يَمْشُونَ⁩ , ⁧نَسُوا⁩ , ⁧يَنْسَوْنَ⁩ , ⁧دَعَوْا⁩ ,
⁧يَدْعُونَ⁩ . They are the forms in which you are wrong most: memorize the line of ⁧هُمْ⁩ .

Verbs with two weak letters (to be recognized; you already know the frequent ones):

blocks.text: Participants maṣdar.
1. Concave: in the active participle the weak letter becomes hamza: ⁧قَائِل⁩ , ⁧بَائِع⁩ , ⁧خَائِف⁩ (as ⁧سَائِق⁩ , A1).
2. Defectives: the active participle ends in -in without article, in -ī with the article: ⁧قَاضٍ⁩ / ⁧القَاضِي⁩ The Judge (from
⁧قَضَى⁩ ), ⁧بَاقٍ⁩ / ⁧البَاقِي⁩ The rest of the product (A2-12), ⁧مَاضٍ⁩ / ⁧المَاضِي⁩ Last, past (A1).
3. Liabilities of defects: ⁧مَدْعُوّ⁩ ( ⁧و⁩ ), ⁧مَنْسِيّ⁩ , ⁧مَبْنِيّ⁩ ( ⁧ي⁩ ).
8. Pronunciation

Long or short. qāla / qultu, bāʿa / biʿtu, ḫāfa / ḫiftu, yaqūlu / lam yaqul: the duration of vowel is the only difference. Exaggerate the lengths at first. -aw, -ay. daʿawtu, mašaytu: the diphthong is clearly felt (da-ʿaw-tu, ma-šay-tu). ⁧مَشَوْا⁩ pronunciation mašaw, ⁧دَعَوْا⁩ daʿaw. The conjunctivo in -wa / -ya. an yadʿuwa, an yamšiya: The w and y are heard.

Notes of use. ⁧أَرْجُو⁩ is also the courteous formula of written requests: ⁧أَرْجُو أَنْ تُرْسِلَ لِي⁩ Please send me... ⁧الرَّجَاءُ عَدَمُ التَّدْخِينِ⁩ Please don't smoke.A2-06). ⁧يَبْدُو أَنَّ⁩ It seems that it introduces a supposition: ⁧يَبْدُو أَنَّهُ نَسِيَ المَوْعِدَ⁩ . ⁧يَشْكُو مِنْ⁩ is also used by your doctor (A2-21): ⁧يَشْكُو مِنْ أَلَمٍ فِي رَأْسِهِ⁩ You have a headache. ⁧يَجْرِي⁩ has two senses: ⁧يَجْرِي كُلَّ صَبَاحٍ⁩ ) and, in the news, "to do so" ( ⁧تَجْرِي الاِنْتِخَابَاتُ يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ⁩ The elections are held on Sunday). ⁧يَقُودُ⁩ is the verb of driving a car ( ⁧يَقُودُ السَّيَّارَةَ⁩ ) and to lead a group; from here ⁧رُخْصَةُ القِيَادَةِ⁩ ( A2-13). ⁧وَصْف⁩ , ⁧ثِقَة⁩ , ⁧وُصُول⁩ , ⁧نِسْيَان⁩ : maṣdar to learn together with the verb.
